Prepregnancy clinical signs of heart failure
cohort: 303 pregnant women with aortic coarctation (CoA) from the worldwide prospective Registry of Pregnancy and Cardiac Disease (ROPAC)
finding: Pregnancy in women with CoA was found to have low rates of MACE (4.3%) and hypertensive disorders (5.3%), suggesting it is more safe and better tolerated than previously appreciated.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was performed in 49.7% of pregnancies in women with aortic coarctation.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at delivery: 39 weeks
